summary.en: The climax: the gap between two points of a print is measured on its own axis, the label computed, the rest of the print stepped back, the claim held in a pause.
summary.zh: 高潮：在截图自己的坐标轴上量出两点之间的差距，标签由计算得到，其余部分退后，主张在停顿中定格。

fits: A cost ratio, a score gap, a latency difference read off one chart.
notFor: Gaps between prints; values with no shared axis.

intent.en: The difference is drawn on the evidence and computed, so the claim cannot be argued with.
intent.zh: 差距画在证据上、由计算得出，主张因此无可辩驳。

content.en: Two points and values on the print; a label pattern; the claim (≤ 6 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 截图上的两个点和值；标签模板；主张（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 从一张图上读出的成本倍数、分数差、延迟差。

notFor.zh: 跨截图的差距；没有共同坐标轴的值。

pairs.note: rise over the desk after the claim

en: Mark values read off an axis with `~`.

fits: any launch argued from published evidence

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
